note: Untap-step phasing is a turn-based action filed with no bracket open; the phasing keyword is a static line and phased-out status is not in the snapshot.
The day/night flip and the transforms it causes happen in the untap step with no bracket open, so no record keeps them; the previous turn's spell count is not carried.
The untap-step untap is filed with no bracket open, so no tap_state target is written; Claustrophobia's no-untap is a static on a non-acting permanent.
No decision record is written in the untap step since no one has priority there, so even the timing column needs records collected there.
